claims.statement: Polish stores selling covered beverages must contract with an operator and agree settlement timing and reporting for acquired and sold covered containers.
EU deposit-return rules require control procedures, collection reporting and transparent fees, while Poland has licensed multiple operators.

contrary_evidence: Operators or POS vendors may provide adequate reconciliation themselves, leaving only low-value edge cases.

thesis: Reconcile beverage sales, returned-container scans, manual returns, cash redeemed, logistics handoffs and operator statements for Polish retailers. The product closes each operator settlement batch, produces evidence for discrepancies and earns a fee when a batch is accepted or a discrepancy is repaid. POS vendors, franchise groups and retail bookkeepers supply one-to-many distribution; verified outcomes build a SKU, machine, store and operator exception graph.
